name: ddc_rotator_lut10_round
description: NCO + complex mixer + gain (10-bit sine table, rounded phase and shifts) vs rotator_cc + multiply_const_cc

params.initial_phase_note: (-phase_inc) mod 65536: ExHdl adds phase_inc before the lookup, so the first sample uses phase 0 like rotator_cc

expect.rationale: Phase rounded to 10 bits: error uniform in [-pi/2^10, pi/2^10), power (2*pi/2^10)^2/12 -> SNR 55.0 dB (+6 dB over truncation). Per sample: |x| * gain * pi/2^10 = 53.1 LSB plus up to 2 LSB from the rounded shifts and the 32767 table amplitude.
